directions.name: Source gravity over overlapping physical ranges
directions.formula: g=GM/r^2 [1+integral B(r/lambda) d alpha(lambda)], B(u)=1-(1+u)exp(-u). Illustrative d alpha=d lambda/L gives a 1/r extra-force regime between finite cutoffs.
directions.next_discriminating_work: Derive a nonlinear continuum range spectrum or source-dependent emergent scale from a universally coupled action, retaining mass-source partition invariance and source reaction. The linear comparator has v_flat proportional to sqrt(M) in its compact-source flat regime; quarter-power behavior requires an emergent L proportional to sqrt(M). Test complete extended sources and Sun/planets inside the external Galactic field. Clusters, light, stability and independent prediction remain required.
directions.warning: This is not a rejection of arbitrary multiscale gravity. The finite ladder is a known-family realization; Item19 documents the subtracted-Yukawa equivalence and prior scoped tests. The proposed spectrum is an illustrative choice, not a first-principles derivation. A per-piece sqrt(m) repair fails source splitting by sqrt(2).

directions.name: Elastic or nonlinear constitutive gravity response
directions.formula: A literal added Hooke pull g_extra proportional to r gives v proportional to r when dominant. A nonlinear field law div[mu(|grad Phi|/a0)grad Phi]=4pi G rho with mu approximately |grad Phi|/a0 gives the known spherical sqrt(GMa0)/r response.
directions.next_discriminating_work: Specify real field degrees of freedom, stored energy, constitutive law and universal coupling; derive the source-dependent collective response rather than merely naming a fitted force elastic. Distinguish a new mechanism from known MOND-like equations and the historical Item38 formula. Require a reason for different cluster response while preserving the local limit and full matter/light dynamics.
directions.warning: This analytic slope result does not reject nonlinear elasticity or finite-range springs. The earlier Item38 elastic-transition trial had a development improvement and failed unchanged transfers and was not promoted. No new astronomical scores were produced here.
